title: Finite research construction: signed P104 mixed-carrier banks and E8 root-line gate (no new kappa)
body:
## Research scope
Adds a finite schematic P104 construction with reusable signed pair mixtures, plus a native-realization obstruction. This is NOT a legal P104 supplier, new conditional exponent, or full multiplication theorem. Builds on #968 and merged #1125, with #2820 as projection-width context.

## Finite result
Within a specified F2-frame, home-return direct baseline, exhaustive search of 4096 cube-edge banks gives 288 signed ADDs and 1312 frame-rank units versus 416 ADDs and 2224 rank units for the stipulated nonoptimized unmixed schedule. Unique rank-winning 12-edge bank uses 24 redundant auxiliaries. Primary checker exhausts 2288 signed target instances and 105 fixed matchings.

## Physical gate
The composite line u_i + u_j is never an existing E8 root-line label. New root_line_gate.py reconstructs 120 root-line pairing signatures and rejects direct root-line adapters for all 7140 unordered pairs. This forbids a simple relabeling, not all generalized-frame implementations.

## Verification
Run: python3 -I -B research/p104-signed-mixed-carrier-bank/RUN_SUBMITTED.py
Expected: PASS_P104_SCHEMATIC_SUBMISSION no_kappa no_native_supplier
This exact pushed code passed isolated Python on a separate Windows machine.

## Outstanding obligations
Native generalized-line lowering, full source and phase access, helper ownership/cleanup, strict recursive children, physical hosting, a competitive optimized unmixed comparator, and selected moment/outer checks. This branch leaves upstream/ and selected frontier untouched.
